lines.en: Many feet, very slow.
The path I eat is bare.
I raise my head to find the next leaf.
I move along the leaf's rim.
Too far above ground makes me anxious.
I just chewed through a leaf.
Fine stripes run along me.
Fragments trail behind me.
I head where the leaves are.
There is a small horn at my rear.
I pause for a couple of bites.
I climb the stem.
I am looking for tender leaves.
I lie flat on the leaf.
Still, I look like a curled leaf.
I am slowly chewing a leaf.
My body pulsed once.
I rub my head with a front leg.
This leaf will last me a while.
I lift my front and listen.
I feel a little cold.
I am counting the leaf's veins.
I cannot be bothered to move.
I hide from the sun beneath the leaf.
I spun a little silk to hold on.
You are so much bigger than me.
Are you going to eat me?
I shrank back a little.
I raise my head to look at you.
I am striped; I taste bad.
Do not step on this leaf.
I know your shadow.
Your hand is too close.
I slip under the leaf.
I do not flee; I am too slow.
I fell off the leaf.
A bit of me is torn.
I spat a little green fluid.
I cannot cry; I have no voice.
I uncurl slowly.
And now you step on me too.
I cannot crawl any further.
I only want a leaf.
Leaves. I need leaves.
I cannot eat that.
Is that a flower in your hand?
Put it on the leaf.
I cannot bite through this.
Where are the tender leaves?

lines.zh: 你手上的味道不像叶子
lines.en: Your hand does not smell like leaves.
I am hungry, but not for that.
You knocked me off.
I caught the leaf's edge.
You pressed my tail.
I curled and rolled half a turn.
I dropped to the leaf below.
Your boot edge brushed me.
I am fine, only startled.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的叶子，也踩到我。
lines.en: You stepped on my leaf, and on me too.
I am not there yet.
I have to grow first.
I only want to eat and sleep.
That is far from my concerns.
I am on a leaf; not this.
I cannot even be bothered to lift my head.
Do not interrupt my meal.
I go back to the veins.
Let me be quiet.
My feet only grip leaves.
I cannot carry it in my mouth.
I can only eat leaves.
That is not on my menu.
It is pressing on my leaf.
Please move it away.
This job is yours to do.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的脚还勾着叶脉。
lines.en: Easy there, my feet are still hooked on the veins of the leaf.
I only fix on leaves.
I will go around you.
I am not attacking anyone.
That leaf over there is better.
I need to crawl over there.
Stand still and do not move.
I will pass by your boot.
I lock only onto tender leaves.
Do not block the light.
The leaf sways; I hold on.
I am still some way from that leaf.
I am halfway through this leaf.
I am getting fatter.
The skin on me feels tight.
I cross the bend of the stem.
There is a fresh leaf ahead.
I stop to rest.
I will get there eventually.
I bumped you.
I can only push forward.
This does not count as an attack.
I bit you, very lightly.
The leaf cut you.
I curled up in fright.
I fell off the leaf.
Do not bring your foot down.
I am on this leaf.
The plain's leaves suit me best.

lines.zh: 刚破卵，身上的水还没干。
lines.en: Just out of the egg, the water on me has not dried.
My first meal is this leaf.
I crawled up here.
I am safe here.
Look under the leaf.

lines.zh: 我第一次见这么大的东西
lines.en: I have never seen anything so big.
Fire makes me clench tight.
I hit the dirt and went limp.

lines.zh: 泡在水里，连叶子都摸不到。
lines.en: Underwater, I cannot even find a leaf.
Something sharp went into me.
The spell makes me numb.
Without leaves, I starve.
Thunder makes me press into the veins.
There are no leaves here.
